Implemented `solve(payload, config)` in `/Volumes/Models/ds4/.workspaces/server-agent-day-20261004/fresh32-visible/bucket/solution.py`.

It uses exact integer arithmetic, starts with `tokens = capacity` at time 0, refills before each event based on elapsed time since the previous event timestamp, caps at capacity, advances the timestamp, accepts costs within the balance, rejects oversized costs without spending, records zero-based indices and post-event balances, and returns the required dictionary without mutating inputs.
